title: AQSh spot Bitcoin ETF: haftada $986,9 mln, uch haftada $3,8 mlrd
summary: SoSoValue: 5-sentabrda yakunlangan haftada AQSh spot BTC ETF lari $986,9 mln sof kirim. Oxirgi uch hafta $3,8 mlrd — 2026-yilning eng kuchli uch haftalik seriyasi.
body:
AQSh spot Bitcoin ETF lari 5-sentabrda yakunlangan savdo haftasida $986,9 million sof kirim yozdi. SoSoValue: oxirgi uch haftalik yigindi $3,8 milliard — 2026-yildagi eng kuchli ketma-ket uch haftalik oqim.

Payshanba $730,8–731 mln (14-yanvardan beri eng yirik kun). Juma $174,6 mln: IBIT $117,4 mln (~67%), FBTC $57,2 mln. Net aktivlar $101,3 mlrd, kumulativ kirim $55,6 mlrd. YTD taxminan -$1 mlrd.

Manba: SoSoValue, Cointelegraph.

title: Ether va XRP ETF kirimi bir haftada 74% va 83% ga pasaydi
summary: SoSoValue: Ether ETF $824,4 mln dan $218,4 mln ga, XRP ETF $110,5 mln dan $19 mln ga tushdi.
body:
AQSh spot Ether ETF sof kirimi $824,4 milliondan $218,4 millionga (-74%) tushdi. XRP ETF $110,5 milliondan $19 millionga (-83%). Bitcoin ETF kirimi haftadan haftaga taxminan +7%.

Juma: BTC ETF +$174,6 mln, ETH ETF +$26,5 mln. Avvalgi 12 kunlik Ether seriyasi $1,62 mlrd edi.

Manba: SoSoValue, Cointelegraph.
